context.description: Apply is pure and guards its input

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-RM6.spec.ts (3 tests, my own run: 3 pass, 0 fail, 211 expect calls, 4.5 s). Given (a running release-notes run): the plan comes from Blend.load via loadPlan; a fold through engine.initial/apply leaves T1.1-T1.3 trusted, T1.4 building, T1.5 and T1 waiting, S1 waiting, status active, run running (all asserted). When (a fact that matches no row): 12 facts, each with no row in its unit's current state or naming no unit (task.ready on a waiting task, proof and verdict on a building task, start on a trusted task, stale on a pending obligation, outside.trusted naming a task, scenario facts on waiting scenarios, unknown ids T7, T7.c1, S99, T42). Then (identical snapshot, input not mutated): each apply result is === the input; a full text of status, value, context, sorted tags, node ids, children, output and error is unchanged, the log length is unchanged, and the fact itself is unchanged; a matching fact moves to a new snapshot and still leaves the input intact; with context and value deep-frozen, the input folds one fact of every stored type without a write and gives the same snapshots as an unfrozen twin. And (ended run returns that snapshot unchanged): five runs that ended in each way (cancel, run.ended done, run.ended failed, observed facts plus a stop, a cascade run that settles by itself) are asserted status done with their outcome; 21 facts of every type and unknown ids each return the identical snapshot, and the snapshot text is unchanged; a control shows the port's raw transition does step a done snapshot, so the guard is the engine's. And (another machine's snapshot makes apply die): a cascade snapshot, a snapshot from a second load of the same spec (a different machine), a snapshot of a machine rebuilt from the plan's own config, and a later cascade run snapshot each make apply die (Cause.hasDies, no typed failure) with 'another plan's machine'; the plan's own snapshot is accepted. Real loader and engine; nothing under test is mocked.
